notes: GAAP city. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (pp6-7). Loan/bond proceeds 4,845,000 printed inside Total revenues 23,598,262 are recorded in debt_proceeds (reported_totals includes debt_proceeds); receipts list excludes it. Roll-forward: 19,139,171 + 18,753,262 - 24,147,114 + 4,845,000 = 18,590,319. Transfers in/out 3,076,422 each. ending_cash = Cash and cash equivalents on governmental funds Balance Sheet total (6,040,239, p5); certificates of deposit 12,384,934 and county treasurer cash 113,132 are separate lines there. Business-type: Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position, Total Enterprise Funds (p9) (Water, Sewer, Landfill); internal service fund column (health insurance) not included. Business-type receipts = operating revenues 8,483,334 + nonoperating interest, grant income and gain on sale (computed, no single printed total); disbursements = total operating expenses 6,458,921 + interest expense 392,667 + bond fees 147,543 = 6,999,131 printed as total business-type expenses on Statement of Activities (p2). Net position change 2,723,259 ties. Business-type expense categories are all 'utilities' by function (object-level lines). Proprietary cash flows: Total column (p11) of the Statement of Cash Flows, enterprise funds. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position Total primary government column (p1); due from/to other funds nets to zero and is omitted. Detail: budget schedules (cash basis, pp14-19) for General, Street, CDBG, Debt Service, LB 357, Capital Projects (amounts differ slightly from GAAP statement); nonmajor combining Total column (p21) because 7 nonmajor funds. General Fund departments schedule (p22) is truncated (right-hand columns Fire/EMS, Library, Total etc. not in the trimmed PDF) and is GAAP detail by object for part of the General Fund, so not used to avoid double counting with the budget schedule; the left columns would add detail by object if the full page were available. Debt Service budget schedule prints no revenue total. Capital projects budget schedule has capital outlay '-' actual (budget 2,089,683) so no expenditure line. Read pages 1-22 of 22.
